declarations.docstring: Computes the coefficient of the displayed product by testing agreement of the permutation-paired exponent entries.
An injective natural-valued index function gives coefficient one in the auxiliary series at its paired exponent index.
Builds an auxiliary finitely supported exponent index from a natural-valued function on finite indices.
Evaluating the paired exponent index at a left injection recovers the given exponent.
Evaluating the paired exponent index at a right injection recovers the given exponent.
